datasets.name: ds_enrichment
queryLines:
SELECT
  call_id,
  opportunity_id,
  stage_name AS stage,
  call_tone,
  call_topic,
  service_city,
  tank_size,
  current_supplier,
  competitor_or_quoted_rate,
  promotion_mentioned,
  objection_proximity,
  call_summary,
  CASE
    WHEN call_tone = 'negative' THEN 3
    WHEN call_tone = 'mixed' THEN 2
    WHEN call_tone = 'neutral' THEN 1
    WHEN call_tone = 'positive' THEN 0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS tone_risk_score
FROM
  gold_call_enrichment_enh

datasets.name: ds_findings
queryLines:
SELECT
  `Opp ID` AS opp_id,
  `Salesforce Stage` AS stage,
  Code AS code,
  CASE
    WHEN Code = '—' THEN 'No blocker'
    ELSE `Code Name`
  END AS code_name,
  `Primary` AS is_primary,
  Qualifier AS qualifier,
  Disposition AS disposition,
  Confidence AS confidence,
  Evidence AS evidence,
  final_quoted_rate.rate_type AS rate_type,
  final_quoted_rate.amount AS quoted_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN Code <> '—' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_blocker,
  CASE
    WHEN Disposition = 'hard_blocker' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_hard,
  CASE
    WHEN Disposition = 'hard_blocker' THEN 'Critical'
    WHEN Disposition = 'friction' THEN 'Warning'
    WHEN Disposition = 'resolved' THEN 'Resolved'
    WHEN Disposition = 'mention_only' THEN 'Low'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS severity
FROM
  gold_offer_blocker_summary
ORDER BY
  is_blocker DESC,
  code

datasets.name: ds_competitive_intel
queryLines:
SELECT
  call_id,
  opportunity_id,
  stage_name AS stage,
  current_supplier,
  competitor_or_quoted_rate,
  promotion_mentioned
FROM
  gold_call_enrichment_enh
WHERE
  current_supplier IS NOT NULL
  OR competitor_or_quoted_rate IS NOT NULL
  OR promotion_mentioned IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  opportunity_id,
  call_id
